verdict.rationale: smolagents is an agent-building framework, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no first-party MCP server or endpoint. The only MCP evidence is client-side: agents can use tools from any MCP server. That is the separate MCP-client capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
